IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: STATE-CHARTERED CREDIT UNION PROVIDING FINANCIAL SERVICES TO MEMBERS
IRS990.MissionDesc: A NOT-FOR-PROFIT CREDIT UNION WHOLLY OWNED BY ITS MEMBERS
IRS990.Desc: OFFER LOAN AND DEPOSIT PRODUCTS AND SERVICES TO MEMBERS, AS WELL AS OTHER FINANCIAL SERVICES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE CREDIT UNION IS EXEMPT, UNDER IRC 501(C)(14), FROM MOST FEDERAL AND STATE INCOME TAXES. THE CREDIT UNION HAS FILED TAX RETURNS IN THE PAST FOR ACTIVITIES IT HAS DEEMED TAXABLE AS UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME. THE TAXING AUTHORITIES HAVE THE ABILITY TO ASSESS TAXES, PENALTIES, AND INTEREST FOR ANY YEARS FOR WHICH NO TAX RETURN WAS FILED. IN THE OPINION OF MANAGEMENT, ANY LIABILITY RESULTING FROM TAXING AUTHORITIES IMPOSING INCOME TAXES ON THE NET TAXABLE INCOME FROM ACTIVITIES POTENTIALLY DEEMED TO BE UNRELATED TO THE CREDIT UNION'S EXEMPT PURPOSE IS NOT EXPECTED TO HAVE A MATERIAL EFFECT ON THE CREDIT UNION'S CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL POSITION OR RESULTS OF OPERATIONS. THE CREDIT UNION EVALUATED ITS TAX POSITIONS AND DETERMINED NO UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS EXIST AS OF DECEMBER 31, 2024. THE CREDIT UNION'S 2021 THROUGH 2023 TAX YEARS ARE OPEN FOR EXAMINATION BY FEDERAL AND STATE TAXING AUTHORITIES. THE INCOME FROM THE CUSO, ORGANIZED AS AN LLC, FLOWS THROUGH TO THE CREDIT UNION, AND THEREFORE IS NOT SUBJECT TO FEDERAL AND STATE INCOME TAXES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 6
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: SAN DIEGO COUNTY CREDIT UNION HAS MEMBERS AS SPECIFIED BY ITS BYLAWS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: SAN DIEGO COUNTY CREDIT UNION MEMBERS HAVE THE POWER TO ELECT THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS AT THE ANNUAL MEETING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: SAN DIEGO COUNTY CREDIT UNION MEMBERS HAVE THE RIGHT TO APPROVE THE GOVERNING BODY'S ELECTION AND REMOVAL OF MEMBERS OF THE GOVERNING BODY, AS WELL AS OTHER MATTERS THAT ARE SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF MEMBERS OF THE CREDIT UNION AS THEY OCCUR.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS REVIEWED BY THE CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER, WHO CONSULTS WITH AN EXTERNAL CPA FIRM AND LEGAL COUNSEL AS NEEDED TO ENSURE THE ACCURACY AND SUFFICIENCY OF ALL RESPONSES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS ANNUALLY OBTAINS AN INDEPENDENT PROFESSIONAL ASSESSMENT OF MARKET COMPENSATION FOR THE PRESIDENT AND CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER. THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS REVIEWS THE INDEPENDENT PROFESSIONAL ASSESSMENT OF MARKET COMPENSATION AND RECOMMENDS THE CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER'S COMPENSATION, WHICH IS DISCUSSED AND APPROVED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS. THE DECISION IS CONTEMPORANEOUSLY DOCUMENTED IN A MEMO AND KEPT IN THE CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER'S PERSONNEL FILE. AN INDEPENDENT PROFESSIONAL ASSESSMENT OF MARKET COMPENSATION IS ALSO OBTAINED FOR OTHER EXECUTIVE TEAM MEMBERS (EXECUTIVE VICE PRESIDENTS), AS WELL AS THE SENIOR VICE PRESIDENT/DIRECTOR OF INTERNAL AUDIT. THE PRESIDENT AND CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER REVIEWS AND APPROVES THE COMPENSATION FOR THE EXECUTIVE TEAM. THESE DECISIONS ARE CONTEMPORANEOUSLY DOCUMENTED IN A MEMO AND KEPT IN THEIR RESPECTIVE PERSONNEL FILES. THE LAST TIME THE REVIEW AND APPROVAL PROCESS OCCURRED FOR THE CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER WAS IN NOVEMBER 2023. THE LAST TIME THE REVIEW AND APPROVAL PROCESS OCCURRED FOR OTHER KEY EMPLOYEES WAS IN JANUARY 2024.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: SAN DIEGO COUNTY CREDIT UNION (THE CREDIT UNION) MAKES ITS FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST IN THE SAME TIME AND MANNER AS OTHER DISCLOSURES REQUIRED UNDER INTERNAL REVENUE CODE SECTION 6104. THE CREDIT UNION DOES NOT MAKE ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC.
